title: I’m Making My First Game… But I Can’t Code
author: Affectionate_Ad_9393
selftext: I’m a 3D artist who’s wanted to make a game for years, but I can’t code. AI has finally let me get past that barrier, so I’ve started building my first game in Unity. I’m only a few weeks in, but I decided to document the whole thing.

comments.author: Maximum-Specialist61
comments.body: I always wanted to make a game like inside vibe wise, interesting that you chosen Unity and not unreal because i saw you have some experience with it. Is C4d supports riging and animation exports that can be reused in unity? Gonna keep watch on this project and your progress.

replies.author: Affectionate_Ad_9393
replies.body: Yeah, I was tempted to use Unreal since I’ve used it before, but I’ve only ever used UE5 for cinematics, never for making an actual game. Unity seemed like a better fit for this type of game. And yep, C4D can be used for rigging and animation and exported into Unity. I’m using Mixamo for a lot of the character animation at the moment though, then tweaking things in c4d if needed. Cheers for checking it out! 👍
